new_model_lessons: Separate playful/dramatic expressiveness from serious conflict, aggression, and emotional dysregulation.
Separate mystical/supernatural salience or intuitive experience from mystical curiosity/inquiry.
Preserve attraction, love/attachment, and in-love/Eros as three distinct actor-specific targets.
A dense or fully defined HD relationship field must not be interpreted as proof of reciprocal romantic love.
Partner knowledge complementarity in a particular domain is not the same as global intellectual stimulation or compatibility.
